options.name: all
options.description: Use this option to do saveconfig for all partitions

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: async
options.description: Using this option will run the operation in async mode and return the job id. The job ID can be used later to track the conversion progress via show ns job <id> Command. This option is mostly useful for API to avoid timeouts for large input configuration

options.name: changedpassword
options.description: Option to list all passwords changed which would not work when downgraded to older releases. Takes config file as input, if no input specified, running configuration is considered. Command => query ns config -changedpassword / query ns config -changedpassword /nsconfig/ns.conf

options.name: cip
options.description: The option to control (enable or disable) the insertion of the actual client IP address into the HTTP header request passed from the client to one, some, or all servers attached to the system. The passed address can then be accessed through a minor modification to the server. l    If cipHeader is specified, it will be used as the client IP header. l    If it is not specified, then the value that has been set by the set ns config CLI command will be used as the client IP header.

options.name: cipheader
options.description: The text that will be used as the client IP header.

options.name: config
options.description: configuration File to be used to find weak passwords, if not specified, running config is taken as input.

options.name: config1
options.description: Location of the configurations.

options.name: config2
options.description: Location of the configurations.

options.name: configfile
options.description: Full path of config file to be converted to nitro

options.name: cookieversion
options.description: The version of the cookie inserted by system.

options.name: crportrange
options.description: Port range for cache redirection services.

options.name: exclusivequotamaxclient
options.description: The percentage of maxClient to be given to PEs

options.name: exclusivequotaspillover
options.description: The percentage of spillover threshold to be given to PEs

options.name: force
options.description: Configurations will be cleared without prompting for confirmation.

options.name: ftpportrange
options.description: Port range configured for FTP services.

options.name: grantquotamaxclient
options.description: The percentage of shared quota to be granted at a time for maxClient

options.name: grantquotaspillover
options.description: The percentage of shared quota to be granted at a time for spillover

options.name: httpport
options.description: The HTTP ports on the Web server. This allows the system to perform connection off-load for any client request that has a destination port matching one of these configured ports.

options.name: ifnum
options.description: Interfaces of the appliances that must be bound to the NSVLAN.

options.name: ignoredevicespecific
options.description: Suppress device specific differences.

options.name: ipaddress
options.description: IP address of the Citrix ADC. Commonly referred to as NSIP address. This parameter is mandatory to bring up the appliance.

options.name: level
options.description: Types of configurations to be cleared. * C(basic): Clears all configurations except the following:   - NSIP, default route (gateway), static routes, MIPs, and SNIPs   - Network settings (DG, VLAN, RHI and DNS settings)   - Cluster settings   - HA node definitions   - Feature and mode settings   - nsroot password * C(extended): Clears the same configurations as the 'C(basic)' option. In addition, it clears the feature and mode settings. * C(full): Clears all configurations except NSIP, default ro

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: maxconn
options.description: The maximum number of connections that will be made from the system to the web server(s) attached to it. The value entered here is applied globally to all attached servers.

options.name: maxreq
options.description: The maximum number of requests that the system can pass on a particular connection between the system and a server attached to it. Setting this value to 0 allows an unlimited number of requests to be passed.

options.name: netmask
options.description: Netmask corresponding to the IP address. This parameter is mandatory to bring up the appliance.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: nsvlan
options.description: VLAN (NSVLAN) for the subnet on which the IP address resides.

options.name: outtype
options.description: Format to display the difference in configurations.

options.name: pmtumin
options.description: The minimum Path MTU.

options.name: pmtutimeout
options.description: The timeout value in minutes.

options.name: rbaconfig
options.description: RBA configurations and TACACS policies bound to system global will not be cleared if RBA is set to C(NO).This option is applicable only for BASIC level of clear configuration.Default is C(YES), which will clear rba configurations.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: responsefile
options.description: Full path of file to store the nitro graph. If not specified, nitro graph is returned as part of the API response.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: securecookie
options.description: enable/disable secure flag for persistence cookie

options.name: securemanagementtd
options.description: This positive integer identifies Management traffic domain. If not specified, defaults to 4094

options.name: securemanagementtraffic
options.description: This enabled secure management traffic handling.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: tagged
options.description: Specifies that the interfaces will be added as 802.1q tagged interfaces. Packets sent on these interface on this VLAN will have an additional 4-byte 802.1q tag which identifies the VLAN. To use 802.1q tagging, the switch connected to the appliance's interfaces must also be configured for tagging.

options.name: template
options.description: File that contains the commands to be compared.

options.name: timezone
options.description: Name of the timezone

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: weakpassword
options.description: Option to list all weak passwords (not adhering to strong password requirements). Takes config file as input, if no input specified, running configuration is considered. Command => query ns config -weakpassword  / query ns config -weakpassword /nsconfig/ns.conf
